classification.difficultyReason: Check both exhaustive coverage and non-overlap, detecting missing aces and shared boundary outcomes.

inlines.text: Identify whether these are complementary events.
Riding a bike home from school
Picking a picture card (J, Q or K) from a deck of 52 cards.
Picking a number card (2–10) from the deck.
Rolling at least a three on a die.
Rolling three or less on a die.

answer.worked: Not getting out of bed is exactly getting out of bed not occurring. The events cover all outcomes and cannot occur together.
Not walking home also includes travelling by car or bus. The two events do not cover all possible outcomes.
Aces are neither picture cards (J, Q, K) nor number cards (2–10). The events do not cover all 52 cards.

answer.short: At least/at most three: Not complementary.
answer.worked: Rolling 3 belongs to both events. Complementary events cannot occur together.
